task.description:
Start all required backend services so TEST-RUNNER can execute E2E tests.

1. docker-compose up -d db db_test keycloak
2. Wait until all containers are healthy: docker-compose ps
3. Verify Keycloak: curl -sf http://localhost:8081/health/ready
4. Verify DB: try connecting via psql or docker-compose exec
5. Start the BPM backend: run start-backend.ps1 or equivalent in the background
6. Verify BPM: curl -sf http://localhost:8080/health/ready
7. Run: zig build migrate
Return PASS only when all services respond and zig build migrate exits 0.
acceptance_criteria: docker-compose ps shows db, db_test, keycloak all healthy

result.summary: All required backend services started and verified healthy. db (postgres:15-alpine, port 5432): healthy. db_test (postgres:15-alpine, port 5433): healthy. keycloak (keycloak:26.2): healthy. keycloak_gateway (nginx:1.27-alpine, port 8081): healthy. BPM backend (port 8080): healthy, db_latency_ms=3. zig build migrate exited 0, applied 1 new migration (059_fix_audit_chain_trigger_args.sql).
